summary: Nginx is installed, enabled, and serving `/` successfully over TCP 6700 on all four managed nodes.
actions_performed: Installed Nginx from native AlmaLinux and Alpine repositories.
Configured dedicated IPv4/IPv6 listeners on TCP 6700 with node-specific index pages.
Enabled Nginx at boot using systemd on AlmaLinux and OpenRC on Alpine.
Permitted TCP 6700 through AlmaLinux firewalld and SELinux while keeping SELinux enforcing.
Validated configuration, service state, listeners, and HTTP 200 responses using each node's managed IP.

evidence.requirement: node1 runs AlmaLinux 9 and serves `/` over HTTP on TCP 6700
evidence.summary: Shows AlmaLinux 9.6, successful Nginx configuration validation, active/enabled service, IPv4/IPv6 port-6700 listeners, enforcing SELinux and firewall permissions, and HTTP/1.1 200 with `nginx on node1`.

evidence.requirement: node2 runs AlmaLinux 9 and serves `/` over HTTP on TCP 6700
evidence.summary: Shows AlmaLinux 9.6, successful Nginx configuration validation, active/enabled service, IPv4/IPv6 port-6700 listeners, enforcing SELinux and firewall permissions, and HTTP/1.1 200 with `nginx on node2`.

evidence.summary: Shows Alpine Linux 3.23, valid Nginx configuration, started/default-runlevel service, IPv4/IPv6 port-6700 listeners, and HTTP/1.1 200 with `nginx on node3`.
